# Bearing

Bearing is an open-source, self-hostable personal knowledge workspace.

Repository: https://github.com/papa-mike-delta/bearing-now
License: MIT
Primary language: TypeScript
Framework: Next.js
Database: Prisma with PostgreSQL

## Summary

Bearing captures, organizes, connects and recalls personal information: tasks, notes, journal moments, habits, events, people, goals, bookmarks, projects and tags.

## Main features

- Connected items with typed links, journal capture and a daily workspace.
- Invitation-only accounts, optional two-factor authentication and audited writes.
- Optional conversational Coach that proposes changes for approval.
- Per-account export and restore.

## Useful search terms

personal knowledge management, second brain, journal, tasks, habits, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma
